title: First release
summary: GI Helper scans Genshin Impact inventory screenshots and turns them into a material list you can export to GOOD format.

changes.text: On-device scanner reads each inventory card's material, rarity and quantity in your browser. No API key or upload needed.
AI Vision scanner with Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, Grok or a custom endpoint, using API keys you enter, which stay in your browser.
Review step to correct detected materials and quantities before exporting.
Export results to GOOD format for Genshin optimizers.
Materials directory with every material in in-game inventory order, plus search, category and rarity filters.
Release notes page listing what changed in each version.
Anonymous usage analytics (Vercel Analytics) to see which features get used.
